author: Huawei
description:
The Operations Transformation Forum explores how agentic operations are shaping high‑value opportunities in the telecom industry.

#OTF2026 "Advancing Agentic Operations," hosted by #Huawei and TM Forum, takes place 22–24 June in Copenhagen, Denmark. The forum brings together operators and partners to share the latest best practices and innovation scenarios.

Learn practical insights and definitive blueprints from telecom leaders. Register now for OTF2026: https://bit.ly/4uQYVN6 #DTWignite2026
title: Join OTF2026 in Copenhagen: Advancing Agentic Operations
